# The Atelier — Coat Customizer

> Interactive bespoke coat and blazer customizer at https://suite-customizer.blenspark.com/

## Overview
The Atelier (ATELIER 3D) allows users to browse signature tailored weaves in a collection carousel and open the studio to customize fabric dyes and hardware buttons in real time.

## Garment Collection
- **Camel Twill (`Coat-3`)**: Structured diagonal twill weave.
- **Sage Corduroy (`Coat-2`)**: Textured sage corduroy tailored jacket.
- **Charcoal Pinstripe (`Coat-1`)**: Charcoal pinstripe tailored coat.
- **Cream Linen (`Coat-4`)**: Cream linen blazer with custom fabric dye and button color customization.
- **Highland Check (`Coat-5`)**: Checkered tailored coat.

## Hardware & Button Options
- Jet Black
- Slate Grey
- Ivory White
- Reddish Brown
- Woven Gold
- Emerald green
